reason: My doctor said my magnesium could be low, so I am actually looking for this. At $24.99 launch price with a lab report and money-back, I would try one box, but only at the launch price.
objection: $29.99 is more than Toplux ($23) or Goli ($19) and those last longer. I would not pay full price for a box when I can compare price per day.
would_change_my_mind: If the launch price were not available, or the lab report turned out to be missing for the batch I get, I would go back to the cheaper brands.
